# UT Austin News

> UT Austin News covers groundbreaking research, campus development, and student achievements across medicine, geology, engineering, and technology at The University of Texas at Austin.

This news site highlights the university's research contributions in areas including vaccine development, digital mental health, cancer immunotherapy, and paleontology, alongside campus infrastructure projects and student innovation stories. Coverage emphasizes UT Austin's role as a leading research institution and its iconic campus landmarks.

## Key Topics

- University of Texas at Austin

## Medical Research & Innovation

- [Scientists Map Deadly Hantavirus, Bringing Treatments One Step Closer](https://news.utexas.edu/2026/03/11/scientists-map-deadly-hantavirus-bringing-treatments-one-step-closer): Jason McLellan's lab maps Hantavirus structure advancing vaccine development
- [10-Minute Digital Program Reduces Symptoms of Depression in Landmark Trial](https://news.utexas.edu/2026/03/18/10-minute-digital-program-reduces-symptoms-of-depression-in-landmark-trial): UT researchers demonstrate digital mental health app reduces depression in clinical trial
- [Experimental Chemo Drug May Trick the Immune System Into Fighting Cancer](https://news.utexas.edu/2026/03/17/experimental-chemo-drug-may-trick-the-immune-system-into-fighting-cancer): UT-MD Anderson collaboration develops immunotherapy drug using viral mimicry
- [From Idea to Impact: UT Student Rethinks How Surgeons are Trained](https://news.utexas.edu/2026/02/24/from-idea-to-impact-ut-student-rethinks-how-surgeons-are-trained): UT student Janavi Seshadri innovates surgical training with real-time feedback device

## Geology & Paleontology Research

- [Camila van der Maal: The Future of Geology Research](https://news.utexas.edu/2026/02/16/camila-van-der-maal-the-future-of-geology-research): First-generation geology student Camila van der Maal conducts methane hydrate research
- [Fossil X-ray Reveals New Species of Baby Dino Named for Iconic Korean Cartoon](https://news.utexas.edu/2026/03/19/fossil-x-ray-reveals-new-species-of-baby-dino-named-for-iconic-korean-cartoon): UT paleontologists discover Doolysaurus, new dinosaur species named after Korean cartoon
- [The Tower History Carved in Stone](https://news.utexas.edu/2026/02/17/the-tower-history-carved-in-stone): UT Tower's limestone and granite construction reveals campus history through geology

## Campus Development & Infrastructure

- [UT To Break Ground on Dedicated Residence Hall for Law Students](https://news.utexas.edu/2026/03/16/ut-to-break-ground-on-dedicated-residence-hall-for-law-students): UT School of Law breaks ground on new residence hall at East Dean Keeton
- [Fernanda Leite Receives Prestigious Peurifoy Construction Research Award From American Society of Civil Engineers](https://news.utexas.edu/2026/03/17/fernanda-leite-receives-prestigious-peurifoy-construction-research-award-from-american-society-of-civil-engineers): UT civil engineering professor Fernanda Leite wins ASCE construction research award
